create.name: Nancy Antenucci
create.bio:
Nancy Antenucci, known to many students as Nucc, is a tarot reader, teacher and ritualist who has worked in Minneapolis and St Paul for decades through her practice, Between the Worlds. She came to the cards largely self-taught and treats tarot as a symbolic language in which each of the 78 cards is a lesson in being human; her readings combine pattern recognition with what she calls psychic downloads. Before tarot she worked as a professional dancer and choreographer, and movement, theatre and storytelling still shape how she leads groups.

She has written two books for Llewellyn. Psychic Tarot shows newer readers how to develop their own card language and trust their intuition, and Tarot Rituals collects close to a hundred ceremonies for solo practice and for groups. She gives readings by phone and video and in person on Fridays at an office in St Louis Park, mentors readers through a four-month series of five sessions, and designs rituals and non-religious weddings. She has helped run the Twin Cities Tarot Collective, its monthly Tarot Sandbox and the North Star Tarot gatherings, and has presented at tarot conferences in the United States and China.

books.title: Psychic Tarot
books.author: Nancy Antenucci
books.description: A first book for new readers that draws on her decades of teaching to help them build a personal language for the cards and learn to trust their own intuition while reading.

books.title: Tarot Rituals
books.author: Nancy Antenucci
books.description: Nearly a hundred ceremonies and exercises built around the tarot, for practising alone or leading groups, aimed at readers who want to take their work with the cards further.

courses.title: Tarot Session
courses.description: A one-to-one tarot reading by phone or Zoom, or in person on Fridays in St Louis Park, focused on practical information for life changes, relationships, work and creative direction. Group readings for gatherings are also offered.

courses.title: Mentoring: The Series of Five
courses.description: Five sessions over about four months that use the tarot alongside creative exercises to support a chosen change, or to train as a reader working through her books. A regular reading comes first to check the fit.

courses.title: Rituals and Ceremonies
courses.description: Custom rituals designed and led for gatherings, conferences and life events, including non-religious and tarot-themed weddings, which she performs as an ordained officiant.
